notes: Editor glosses «- قال أبو داود كذا قال محمد -» and «- أو قال قال علي -» are left out; the second names the same Ali as an alternative wording.
«قال ابن عيسى هكذا حدثنا هشيم» is a wording remark from the first link (same man): left out.
«شيخ، من بني تميم» is a man the text does not name: unnamed. Ali's sermon makes him the last link.
